text: JMAP session endpoint exposes capabilities, accounts, and API URLs for discovery
quote: Fetch `/.well-known/jmap` for the session object - capabilities, accounts, and all API URLs.

text: API authentication uses standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens instead of a custom protocol
quote: Standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. No custom auth protocol to implement. Works with what you already have.

text: Real-time push notifications via a single EventSource connection covering all mailboxes, or WebPush for mobile
quote: Get instant push via EventSource — one connection, all mailboxes. Or use WebPush for mobile-compatible push, no permanent connection required.

text: JMAP protocol enables faster, more efficient sync, often in a single HTTP roundtrip
quote: Sync changes more easily, more efficiently, and much, much faster. A single HTTP roundtrip is often all that's required.

text: Users can create API tokens for programmatic access
Filters and rules can automatically act on incoming mail
Full-text search across mail with support for finding messages quickly
Comprehensive keyboard shortcuts for navigating and operating the client
Saved templates let users reuse boilerplate content instead of retyping replies
Undo send lets users recall a sent message within a grace window
Two-step verification (2FA) can be enabled for account security
Users can set up email aliases for their account
quote: How to set up aliases – Fastmail

text: Mail (and presumably contacts) can be imported from a previous provider
Calendar events and meeting invitations can be viewed and managed within the client
Users can log in to and manage multiple accounts from one interface
quote: Logging in to multiple accounts – Fastmail

text: Offline support lets users read and interact with mail without a connection, syncing later
Scheduled Send lets users compose an email now and have it sent at a later time
Masked Email generates unique addresses per site to hide a user's real email
JMAP sync uses roughly 2-3x less power than IMAP on real devices
quote: 2–3× less power usage than IMAP, measured on real devices.

text: JMAP is an open standard implementable by any organisation, avoiding proprietary lock-in
quote: JMAP is an open standard any organisation can implement, not more proprietary lock-in from big tech companies.

text: Fastmail publishes documentation on its open-source components and standards support
Dedicated migration guide/tooling to move an inbox from Gmail
A single request can batch multiple JMAP method calls to query, fetch, and send mail in one round trip
quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.

text: Users can get email hosted for their own custom domain
Fastmail publishes API documentation for developers
Messages can be snoozed to reappear in the inbox at a chosen future time
quote: Snooze messages to just when you need them. Whether it’s tickets to that stadium gig in September, or a bill due next Thursday, sometimes you receive an email now that you need to see then.
